attempt.unit: one condition of one task/repetition pair

comparability.agent_parallelism_nonpoolability_reason: measured-v5 disables subagents and permits exactly one root agent per attempt; measured-v4 allowed four root/subagent threads
comparability.memory_peak_nonpoolability_reason: measured-v5 records a fresh condition cgroup's lifetime high-water; measured-v2 used a reset window in a shared cgroup

condition_isolation.L: the campaign-locked external NumStability source, compiled objects, and docs/LIBRARY_LOOKUP.md are mounted read-only
condition_isolation.N: no NumStability source, compiled object, documentation, checkout, cache, or import path is mounted

lifecycle.environment: resolved, built, and locked only when a campaign is created
lifecycle.task_corpus: locked independently by metadata/task_corpus_lock.json and rechecked before campaign creation and every attempt

resources.memory_peak_metric: read-only lifetime high-water of the fresh condition memory cgroup

telemetry.hidden_chain_of_thought_note: Only reasoning text or summaries actually emitted by the agent API can be recorded. Private chain-of-thought is not observable and is never reconstructed.
